request: I run a community football league in Kumasi and I need to keep track of our fixtures. First we add the teams, each with its name. Then we schedule a fixture on a date between a home team and an away team, and of course a team cannot play against itself. After the match we record the score, meaning how many goals each side scored, and a score can never be negative. We also want to see all the fixtures of one team, whether that team plays at home or away.
summary:
I've built the backend for your league as one file, `app.py`. It saves everything in a file called `league.db` in the same folder. I wrote 22 automatic checks covering everything in the plan, and they all pass. I didn't start the server and try it by hand.

**Endpoints**
- **POST /teams**: adds a team. Send `{"name": "Asante Stars"}` and you get back the team with its number.
- **GET /teams**: lists all teams.
- **POST /fixtures**: schedules a match. Send `{"date": "2025-03-01", "home_team_id": 1, "away_team_id": 2}`. The score starts out empty.
- **GET /fixtures**: lists all fixtures with their date, teams and score (if recorded), earliest date first.
- **PUT /fixtures/{fixture number}/score**: records the score. Send `{"home_goals": 2, "away_goals": 0}`.
- **GET /teams/{team number}/fixtures**: lists every fixture for one team, home and away.

**What gets refused (with an error message)**
- A team with no name, or a name that's only spaces.
- A fixture missing its date, home team or away team.
- A fixture where either team hasn't been added yet.
- A fixture where a team plays against itself.
- A score missing either side's goals, or with goals that are negative, not whole numbers, or not numbers at all.
- A score for a fixture that doesn't exist.
- Asking for the fixtures of a team that doesn't exist. The message says the team was not found.

**Your plan's open questions, and how the system works now:**
- **Who can make changes:** anyone who can reach the system can add teams, schedule fixtures and record scores.
- **Same names:** two teams can have the same name.
- **Changing scores:** you can record a score again, and the new one replaces the old.
- **Fixing mistakes:** there's no way to edit or delete teams or fixtures.

Tell me if you'd like any of these changed.

plan.summary: This plan covers a simple system for your Kumasi community football league. It keeps a list of teams (each with a name) and a list of fixtures. A fixture is a match on a set date between a home team and an away team. After the match is played, you record the score: how many goals each side scored. You can also look up every fixture for one team, whether that team played at home or away. The system will refuse a fixture where a team plays against itself, and it will refuse any score below zero. Everything in your request was about the backend, so nothing was left out. A few questions for you, which are not in the plan unless you ask for them: Should anyone be allowed to add teams, schedule fixtures and record scores, or only certain people? Should two teams be allowed to have the same name? Should a score be allowed to be changed once it has been recorded? Would you like to be able to edit or delete teams and fixtures if a mistake is made?

data.name: Team
fields: Team number (given automatically so each team can be told apart)

data.name: Fixture
fields: Fixture number (given automatically so each fixture can be told apart)
Home team (one of the teams already added)
Away team (one of the teams already added)
Goals scored by the home team (empty until the score is recorded)
Goals scored by the away team (empty until the score is recorded)

endpoints.does: Adds a new team to the league, using the name you give it.
Shows the list of all teams in the league.
Schedules a new fixture on a date between a home team and an away team.
Shows the list of all fixtures, with their dates, teams and scores if recorded.
Records the score of a fixture after the match: how many goals the home team scored and how many the away team scored.
Shows every fixture of one team, both the matches where it plays at home and the matches where it plays away.

rules: A team must have a name; adding a team without a name is refused.
A fixture must have a date, a home team and an away team; a fixture missing any of these is refused.
The home team and the away team must both be teams that have already been added; otherwise the fixture is refused.
A team cannot play against itself: a fixture where the home team and the away team are the same team is refused.
A score must include the goals for both sides; a score missing either number is refused.
Goals must be whole numbers of zero or more; any negative score is refused.
A score can only be recorded for a fixture that exists; otherwise it is refused.
Looking up the fixtures of a team that does not exist is refused with a message saying the team was not found.
